[[File:Bone shortbow detail.png|left|150px]]
The '''bone shortbow''' is a two-handed [[Ranged weapons|ranged weapon]] requiring level 50 [[Ranged]] to wield. It is made by combining a [[yew shortbow]] with [[Scurrius' spine]], requiring a [[knife]] and level 35 [[Fletching]] to do so; players without the required level can alternatively pay [[Historian Aldo]] 50,000 [[coins]] to create it on their behalf. The bow has identical offensive stats to the [[magic shortbow]], and can fire up to [[amethyst arrows]].

As a [[rat bone weapon]], it is effective against all types of [[rat (attribute)|rats]] by adding 10 damage to the player's [[maximum hit]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1754468057638973449|date=5 February 2024|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106036|archivedate=5 February 2024|quote=Looks like a static +10 in the code, from what I can see.}} The shortbow '''cannot be used''' against any other type of monster (including manually cast [[spell]]s); doing so will yield the game message {{Mes|You can only use this weapon against rats.}} Additionally, this weapon has no attack cooldown when attacking the [[Giant rat (Scurrius)|giant rats]] that [[Scurrius]] summons.
